_comment: PRIORITIZED harvest for fastest VISIBLE results. Reuses the SAME output/state files as harvest.config.json so every already-completed chunk is skipped (no duplicate datasource hits). Scope is narrowed to the only two geo levels the map renders (Counties, 2010 Census Tracts) and the high-value choropleth categories. Excludes 211 Helpline Calls (heavy, low marginal visibility), Sites/Programs/Agencies (covered by the separate harvest_sites.js pipeline), and Political Boundaries. To go back to the full deep harvest, use harvest.config.json.
